messages:
opsbot: :rotating_light: Alert 1748009999 — elevated GPU preemptions and request failures in us-west-2. Signal: node preemptions + increased p95. Auto-routing triggered.

oncall-nyc: seeing the page, joining. checking current runbook. any deploys in last 30m?

michael.k: no deploys. cloud reports multiple spot preemptions on a small subset of g4dn pools — charlie nodes. KV proxy retries spiking.

sara: p95 across the region jumped from 95ms -> 420ms, error rate ~1.8% 5m window. Cause looks infra-level (preemptions) not model.

opsbot: automated mitigation: started incremental routing to us-east-1 model replicas and enabled burst capacity on dedicated-reserve-2. Est. cutover in ~45s.

jess.product: can we also fallback to quantized-1 (lower perf but fewer OOMs) for new sessions? might reduce tail.

michael.k: yes — toggled model-fallback policy to prefer quantized-v1 for new cold sessions in us-west-2. will keep warm sessions pinned.

infra-rotations: scaling burst pool + forcing reroute now. watching KV cache churn — may see small increase in token cost for customers during burst.

oncall-nyc: initial improvement visible — p95 trending down to ~220ms after routing change. error rate down to 0.6%. still higher than baseline.

opsbot: NOTE: incident classification: P2 (regional performance degradation). SLA impact: degraded p95 for subset of customers in us-west-2. No data exfiltration.

jess.product: drafting customer notification. suggestion below — please quick-review.

jess.product: ```
Status: Degraded performance in US West (us-west-2)
Start: 2025-05-12 02:46 UTC
Impact: Increased latency and intermittent request failures for some customers served from US West. We have routed traffic to alternate replicas and enabled burst capacity — performance is improving. Our on-call will continue monitoring and we will post updates.
Mitigation: traffic rerouted, burst capacity enabled, fallback to quantized model for new sessions.
ETA: 30-60 minutes for full recovery depending on node stabilization.
```

customer-success: please hold — we'll coordinate outbound comms. two customers in tier-enterprise are already on slack, prepping a tailored note.

michael.k: quick ops note: if preemptions continue after 30 min, next step is to drain the affected host group and provision on-demand GPUs. that is manual and takes ~12-18m.

infra-rotations: confirmed — provisioning runbook at hand. flagging for follow-up if <10% improvement in next 20m.

oncall-nyc: handing off to sara (UTC-7) for ongoing monitoring. I will add details to the incident doc and update status page.

sara: acknowledged — I'll take 1hr watch and escalate if we hit >1% error sustained. updating status now.

opsbot: statuspage update queued: "Investigating — routing changes in progress to mitigate elevated latency in US West. Customers on impacted routes may see slower responses or intermittent failures."

jess.product: small ask to CS: please send the short tailored note to the two engaged enterprise customers now — include that we routed traffic and enabled fallback; we'll follow with a post-incident summary.

customer-success: sending now, will post the text in #customer-updates once sent.

michael.k: monitoring KV hit ratios + retries. if retries remain high after stabilization, we'll enable aggressive prefix caching for affected models (low risk).

infra-rotations: FYI — there is a known firmware rollout scheduled in that AZ earlier today; correlating logs now. might be related.

opsbot: next update required by 1748010250 (15m). If anyone takes the page, please update thread and statuspage.

sara: thanks — update at 1748010250: p95 ~180ms, error rate 0.3%. keeping watch. no customer escalations new. will continue to monitor for 1hr then TTR.

jess.product: final note for incident doc: mitigation actions taken (traffic reroute, burst enable, quantized fallback) and owner for RCA: infra-ml. please add any logs + node IDs to the doc.

customer-success: posted notifications. customers acknowledged. will collect any impact reports and ping back here. :white_check_mark:
